  section 1-you-bring-the-taste-the-stack-brings-the-hands "1. You bring the taste. The stack brings the hands" rests=false
    block blueprint/philosophy#taste conviction icon=conviction tier=quiet shown=none "You bring the taste. The stack brings the hands."
      field says "You bring the taste. The stack brings the hands." 
      field opposite "The tool decides the style and the context for you: a house prompt, a default voice, a template of how work should be done." 
      field carried_in ""  refs=product/stack#wiki
      field broken_by "Shipping a built-in persona or style that overrides what you wrote, or letting one fact live in two places, so that an agent reads the stale copy." 
  section 2-delegating-is-a-craft-not-a-prompt "2. Delegating is a craft, not a prompt" rests=false
    block blueprint/philosophy#delegating conviction icon=conviction tier=quiet shown=none "Delegating is a craft, not a prompt."
      field says "Delegating is a craft, not a prompt." 
      field opposite "One strong agent, given every task in one long conversation." 
      field carried_in ""  refs=product/stack#agents,product/stack#os
      field broken_by "A surface that asks you about everything, or one that hides the detail with no way to open it." 
  section 3-rules-live-in-the-world-not-in-the-agent "3. Rules live in the world, not in the agent" rests=false
    block blueprint/philosophy#rules-in-the-world conviction icon=conviction tier=quiet shown=none "Rules live in the world, not in the agent."
      field says "Rules live in the world, not in the agent." 
      field opposite "Give the agent every access and ask it, in its instructions, to be careful." 
      field carried_in ""  refs=product/stack#machines,product/stack#agents
      field broken_by "A guardrail in a prompt used as the security boundary, or a default that hands a VM the credentials of the Mac above it." 
  section 4-declared-never-improvised "4. Declared, never improvised" rests=false
    block blueprint/philosophy#declared conviction icon=conviction tier=quiet shown=none "Declared, never improvised."
      field says "Declared, never improvised." 
      field opposite "Configure by hand, as you go, and forget what you did." 
      field carried_in ""  refs=product/stack#machines,product/stack#agents
      field broken_by "A setting reachable only by a click with no file behind it, or a state the stack holds that no file explains." 
  section 5-done-means-proven "5. Done means proven" rests=false
    block blueprint/philosophy#proven conviction icon=conviction tier=quiet shown=none "Done means proven."
      field says "Done means proven." 
      field opposite "“It seems to work”, said by whoever did the work." 
      field carried_in ""  refs=product/stack#specs
      field broken_by "A status of done set by the agent that did the work, with no check behind it." 
  section 6-taste-is-a-system "6. Taste is a system" rests=false
    block blueprint/philosophy#taste-is-a-system conviction icon=conviction tier=quiet shown=none "Taste is a system."
      field says "Taste is a system." 
      field opposite "Each screen designed on its own, to the taste of the day." 
      field carried_in ""  refs=product/stack#design
      field broken_by "A component drawn by hand for one page when the kit has the piece." 
  section 7-the-stack-learns-you-dont-repeat-yourself "7. The stack learns. You don't repeat yourself" rests=false
    block blueprint/philosophy#learns conviction icon=conviction tier=quiet shown=none "The stack learns. You don't repeat yourself."
      field says "The stack learns. You don't repeat yourself." 
      field opposite "Every session starts from nothing." 
      field carried_in ""  refs=product/stack#agents,product/stack#wiki
      field broken_by "A memory that lives only in a session's context, or a lesson written where no agent will read it." 

page blueprint/philosophy @2min floor=0 Intention seats=[blueprint],product,engineering,growth
  paragraph "The seven convictions Spwn is built on, written as principles a newcomer can apply to a design choice; [the vision](./vision.md) holds the case they serve, and this page holds the rules. The owner confirmed the seven on 2026-11-21 ([his answer](./owner-words.md#why-spwn-exists))."
    block blueprint/philosophy#all table icon=table tier= shown=tile ""
      table conviction in=blueprint/philosophy where="" columns=says,carried_in
        row blueprint/philosophy#taste says="You bring the taste. The stack brings the hands." carried_in="" refs=product/stack#wiki
        row blueprint/philosophy#delegating says="Delegating is a craft, not a prompt." carried_in="" refs=product/stack#agents,product/stack#os
        row blueprint/philosophy#rules-in-the-world says="Rules live in the world, not in the agent." carried_in="" refs=product/stack#machines,product/stack#agents
        row blueprint/philosophy#declared says="Declared, never improvised." carried_in="" refs=product/stack#machines,product/stack#agents
        row blueprint/philosophy#proven says="Done means proven." carried_in="" refs=product/stack#specs
        row blueprint/philosophy#taste-is-a-system says="Taste is a system." carried_in="" refs=product/stack#design
        row blueprint/philosophy#learns says="The stack learns. You don't repeat yourself." carried_in="" refs=product/stack#agents,product/stack#wiki
    plain "Each conviction is written in the same six parts: the statement, the sensible opposite (what a reasonable product does instead, which is why the conviction says something), the argument, where the product carries it, one example, and the decision that would break it. A page that cites a conviction cites its number and links here."
  section 1-you-bring-the-taste-the-stack-brings-the-hands "1. You bring the taste. The stack brings the hands" rests=false
    block blueprint/philosophy#taste conviction icon=conviction tier=quiet shown=counted "You bring the taste. The stack brings the hands."
      field says "You bring the taste. The stack brings the hands." 
      field opposite "The tool decides the style and the context for you: a house prompt, a default voice, a template of how work should be done." 
      field carried_in ""  refs=product/stack#wiki
      field broken_by "Shipping a built-in persona or style that overrides what you wrote, or letting one fact live in two places, so that an agent reads the stale copy." 
    item "**Argument.** What an agent cannot supply is what makes the work yours: your taste, your vision, your context from outside the screen. The owner's point is not to write down how he works but to bring his taste and his context while working at the high level ([the problem](./owner-words.md#the-problem), 2026-11-14)."
    item "**Example.** An agent opening a repository reads your vision and your decisions first, not a generic instruction."
  section 2-delegating-is-a-craft-not-a-prompt "2. Delegating is a craft, not a prompt" rests=false
    block blueprint/philosophy#delegating conviction icon=conviction tier=quiet shown=counted "Delegating is a craft, not a prompt."
      field says "Delegating is a craft, not a prompt." 
      field opposite "One strong agent, given every task in one long conversation." 
      field carried_in ""  refs=product/stack#agents,product/stack#os
      field broken_by "A surface that asks you about everything, or one that hides the detail with no way to open it." 
    item "**Example.** At the end of a day the chief shows what was done and asks you the two questions only you can answer; everything else was settled by the owners of each domain."
  section 3-rules-live-in-the-world-not-in-the-agent "3. Rules live in the world, not in the agent" rests=false
    block blueprint/philosophy#rules-in-the-world conviction icon=conviction tier=quiet shown=counted "Rules live in the world, not in the agent."
      field says "Rules live in the world, not in the agent." 
      field opposite "Give the agent every access and ask it, in its instructions, to be careful." 
      field carried_in ""  refs=product/stack#machines,product/stack#agents
      field broken_by "A guardrail in a prompt used as the security boundary, or a default that hands a VM the credentials of the Mac above it." 
    item "**Example.** An agent cannot break your computer: it is not on it."
  section 4-declared-never-improvised "4. Declared, never improvised" rests=false
    block blueprint/philosophy#declared conviction icon=conviction tier=quiet shown=counted "Declared, never improvised."
      field says "Declared, never improvised." 
      field opposite "Configure by hand, as you go, and forget what you did." 
      field carried_in ""  refs=product/stack#machines,product/stack#agents
      field broken_by "A setting reachable only by a click with no file behind it, or a state the stack holds that no file explains." 
    item "**Example.** `qa.machine.yaml` gives `qa-1`, set up before its first command."
  section 5-done-means-proven "5. Done means proven" rests=false
    block blueprint/philosophy#proven conviction icon=conviction tier=quiet shown=counted "Done means proven."
      field says "Done means proven." 
      field opposite "“It seems to work”, said by whoever did the work." 
      field carried_in ""  refs=product/stack#specs
      field broken_by "A status of done set by the agent that did the work, with no check behind it." 
    item "**Example.** A request comes back with its proof, or it does not come back as done."
  section 6-taste-is-a-system "6. Taste is a system" rests=false
    block blueprint/philosophy#taste-is-a-system conviction icon=conviction tier=quiet shown=counted "Taste is a system."
      field says "Taste is a system." 
      field opposite "Each screen designed on its own, to the taste of the day." 
      field carried_in ""  refs=product/stack#design
      field broken_by "A component drawn by hand for one page when the kit has the piece." 
    item "**Example.** The site's canvas kit: one box, one arrow, one title, the same everywhere."
  section 7-the-stack-learns-you-dont-repeat-yourself "7. The stack learns. You don't repeat yourself" rests=false
    block blueprint/philosophy#learns conviction icon=conviction tier=quiet shown=counted "The stack learns. You don't repeat yourself."
      field says "The stack learns. You don't repeat yourself." 
      field opposite "Every session starts from nothing." 
      field carried_in ""  refs=product/stack#agents,product/stack#wiki
      field broken_by "A memory that lives only in a session's context, or a lesson written where no agent will read it." 
    item "**Example.** A correction given once becomes a rule the next agent reads."

page product/stack @2min floor=1 Produit seats=blueprint,[product],engineering,growth
  paragraph "Spwn's three spaces and what lives in each, for anyone deciding what a part of the app is for or where it goes: per space, what you let go of, what you keep, and whether it runs today. The structure is the owner's, decided on 2026-11-22 ([his words](../blueprint/owner-words.md#the-three-spaces-of-the-app)); the record is [ADR-003](./decisions/003-the-three-spaces-are-the-structure-of-the-app.md). It replaces the six-rung ladder of [ADR-002](./decisions/002-spwn-is-one-stack-of-six-apps-on-one-ladder.md)."
  finding needs-you S6 "product/stack" rests on this page's reading: you have not ruled
  section the-three-spaces "The three spaces" rests=false
    plain "The layers of the Spwn app are three great concepts, and in the future three distinct spaces in its GUI. The owner drew each as the running of a company:"
    head "Space" | "The company it is the parallel of" | "State"
    row "Machine" | "The environment: the fleet of machines, the premises, the access, the security, the documents" | "shipped"
    row "Agent" | "The staff: their personalities, roles, focus and responsibilities" | "shipped"
    row "OS" | "The flows: which project, which vision, which product, which system runs inside; it steers the flows, the system and the abstractions" | "being made"
    plain "Each space is one step of [the method](../blueprint/vision.md#the-method-climb-by-abstraction): a piece of work handed to the stack, a decision kept by you. What you let go of and keep, space by space, in the parts that exist:"

  section how-the-spaces-stack "How the spaces stack" rests=false
    plain "A space leans on the ones before it and never needs the ones after. Agents runs in machines Machines can build; in the OS space, Wiki is what agents read, Specs proves the work against what you and Wiki asked for, Design turns your taste into rules the work is held to, and the OS is the one place you steer from."
  section rests-on "Rests on" rests=true
    plain "One claim here is this page's reading, not the owner's word: that a space leans only on the spaces before it (\"How the spaces stack\"). The placement of Wiki, Specs and Design in the OS space is his; the \"you let go of\" and \"you keep\" columns come from the brief he confirmed on 2026-11-21."

    plain "Spwn is not sold as an agent framework, an AI platform or a tool that makes more output. Each of those is judged by how much it produces, and production is what became cheap ([what changed](../blueprint/vision.md#what-changed)). Spwn is judged by whether you still understand and own what was produced: the one enemy is [losing your thread](../blueprint/vision.md#the-enemy-losing-your-thread)."
    block growth/positioning#lead-with-the-thread rule icon=soft tier=quiet shown=line "A comparison never leads with speed, model quality or the number of integrations."
      field says "A comparison never leads with speed, model quality or the number of integrations." 
      field force "soft" 
      field guards ""  refs=growth/positioning
      field read_at "studio-os:home/spwn/wiki/growth/positioning.md" 
    plain "It leads with what the alternative does to your thread."
  section the-alternatives "The alternatives" rests=false
    group alternatives define blocks=4 folded=author lead=""
      block growth/positioning#by-hand alternative icon=alternative tier=quiet shown=line "you are the bottleneck: what gets built is bounded by your hours"
        field gives "you know every line" 
        field costs "you are the bottleneck: what gets built is bounded by your hours" 
      block growth/positioning#one-big-agent alternative icon=alternative tier=quiet shown=line "the only safety is its instructions; one context holds everything, and you stop knowing what it did"
        field gives "speed, and one place to ask" 
        field costs "the only safety is its instructions; one context holds everything, and you stop knowing what it did" 
      block growth/positioning#managed-platform alternative icon=alternative tier=quiet shown=line "your context, machines and credentials live in their place, worked in their method"
        field gives "someone else runs the agents" 
        field costs "your context, machines and credentials live in their place, worked in their method" 
      block growth/positioning#unrelated-tools alternative icon=alternative tier=quiet shown=line "each keeps its own copy of your context, and you are the integration between them"
        field gives "each tool is good at its part" 
        field costs "each keeps its own copy of your context, and you are the integration between them" 
    block growth/positioning#two-costs figure icon=figure tier= shown=tile "Each costs either scale or authorship."
      figure quad shows=growth/positioning#alternatives "Each costs either scale or authorship."
        part "by hand" at=y
        part "one big agent" at=x
        part "spwn" at=xy
    block growth/positioning#all table icon=table tier= shown=tile ""
      table alternative in=growth/positioning#alternatives where="" columns=gives,costs
        row growth/positioning#by-hand gives="you know every line" costs="you are the bottleneck: what gets built is bounded by your hours"
        row growth/positioning#one-big-agent gives="speed, and one place to ask" costs="the only safety is its instructions; one context holds everything, and you stop knowing what it did"
        row growth/positioning#managed-platform gives="someone else runs the agents" costs="your context, machines and credentials live in their place, worked in their method"
        row growth/positioning#unrelated-tools gives="each tool is good at its part" costs="each keeps its own copy of your context, and you are the integration between them"
    plain "Each costs either scale or authorship. Spwn's answer is to keep both: the work goes to agents, the decisions stay with you, on your machines, from one place for each fact ([the stack](../product/stack.md))."
  section rests-on "Rests on" rests=true
    plain "What is not settled: whether \"the category it refuses\" is said in public, and how, is a positioning call the owner has not made; it is on [open questions](./open-questions.md#positioning-audience-and-pricing). The four alternatives and their costs are this page's argument; the brief the owner confirmed on 2026-11-21 did not list them, so he has not ruled on them."

page machines/reference/ports @30s floor=3 Architecture seats=blueprint,product,[engineering],growth
  paragraph "`station ports` lists every TCP port that listens on a Mac or a VM, each in the class of who reaches it. Which ports a VM may open, and to whom, are its [rights](#right): a port that starts listening inside them is shared with their audience within seconds, one outside them is flagged and never shared."
  section rights-and-audiences "Rights and audiences" rests=false
    block machines/reference/ports#right term icon=term tier=normal shown=none "what a machine may open and to whom, its Machinefile's ports: open, to (its audience), except, audiences"
      field means "what a machine may open and to whom, its Machinefile's `ports`: `open`, `to` (its audience), `except`, `audiences`" 
    block machines/reference/ports#audience term icon=term tier=quiet shown=none "who a right, or the owner's ports share --to, shares a port with: local, private or public"
      field means "who a right, or the owner's `ports share --to`, shares a port with: local, private or public" 
    group what-is-flagged guard blocks=2 folded=budget lead="A port that listens outside the rights is flagged, never shared."
